latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Simple 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Simplify raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and export cleaned 1080p MP4 files in seconds.
- Automatic authentication and cloud session setup—no manual credentials needed.
- Supports video upload, audio/text overlays, silence trimming, and fast export workflows.
- Simple commands to check credits, upload files, preview timeline, and download results.
- Robust handling of common errors (token expiry, file limits, unsupported formats, rate limits).
- Designed for content creators and educators to quickly clean up recordings without manual editing.
